title: config/commit-identity.json
description: The identity that the commits of the repository declare, read by the commit-msg hook and commits-check (check-commits.mts): an author or a committer of a commit that is another identity is refused. kit-sync copies the file into each consumer.

name.description: The name of the person who makes the commits, as user.name of the clone holds it.

email.description: The address of the person who makes the commits, as user.email of the clone holds it.
